text.en:
After casting your barricade, pressing [Class Ability] again will remotely detonate it. <solar/>Shieldburst Barricades apply 50 <solar/>Scorch (75 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes), deal damage, and blast Solar Shrapnel up to 40 meters in front of them. 

<solar/>Shieldburst Barricades passively grow in strength over time and after dealing damage. At maximum strength, the detonation deals 50% increased damage and releases three 15-meter Solar Waves across the ground.

<bold Towering Barricade: />
Your barricade slides 20 meters forward upon cast. Enemies that come into contact with your barricade take a burst of damage and recieve 20 <solar/>Scorch (30 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes). Contact Damage can only trigger once every 2 seconds on the same enemy, and your barricade loses the ability to disorient. Shieldburst passively charges in strength at a rate of 34% per second.

<bold Rally Barricade: />
Your barricade grants <solar/>Scorch Rounds to your <<solar/>Solar and Kinetic weapons. Scorch applied and rate of application varies between weapon archetypes. Shieldburst passively charges in strenth at a rate of 10% per second.

Barricade detonation scales up to 65% increased damage at 200 Class Stat.

Shieldburst counts as 'casting your class ability' both on cast and on remote detonation for the purposes of exotic armor.
